decisions.choice: the passage 7:53-8:11 is printed in the text, set off in brackets as a passage whose place in John is disputed
alternatives: leave the passage out of the text and give it only in a note
print it without any mark, as part of John
decisions.reason: The story of the woman caught in adultery is missing from the earliest manuscripts of John, among them two early papyri (P66 and P75), Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, and from the early versions in other ancient languages. The first manuscript known to have it is Codex Bezae, from the fifth century. In later manuscripts it is found here, but some place it after John 7:36, after 7:44 or at the end of the Gospel after 21:25, and one group places it in Luke, after Luke 21:38. Some manuscripts that have it mark it as doubtful. Its style and vocabulary differ from the rest of John: it names the scribes (verse 3) and the Mount of Olives (8:1), which John does not otherwise mention, and uses other words John rarely uses. Many hold that it is an old and true account of Jesus that was handed down outside John and later written into the Gospel at this point. The SBLGNT prints it here in double brackets. It is translated here in square brackets: the opening bracket at the start of 7:53 and the closing bracket at the end of 8:11 mark where the passage begins and ends. The evidence shows that the passage was not part of the earliest copies of John; it does not decide whether the events took place. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: each: each of those present in the scene before, who now leave for their homes
alternatives: each member of the council of 7:45-52 only
each person in the festival crowd
decisions.reason: In its place here the sentence closes the scene of 7:45-52, where the chief priests and Pharisees argued about Jesus. It also sets up the contrast with Jesus, who does not go home but goes out to the Mount of Olives. The sentence does not say who exactly is meant; it may have come with the story from wherever it was first told.

decisions.choice: the Mount of Olives: the ridge east of Jerusalem, across the Kidron valley
decisions.reason: The Mount of Olives faces the temple across the Kidron valley. This is the only time it is named in John, though the other Gospels often mention it. Luke says that in the last days in Jerusalem Jesus taught in the temple by day and spent the nights on the Mount of Olives, and that all the people came to him early in the morning (Luke 21:37-38). The likeness is one sign that this story comes from a tradition shared with the other Gospels.

decisions.choice: an opening square bracket at the start of 7:53, closed at the end of 8:11
alternatives: no brackets, with a note only
a heading over the passage instead of brackets
decisions.reason: The brackets show the reader where the disputed passage starts and ends (meaning decision m1). At Literal, square brackets also mark words supplied in English; inside the passage they keep that use, and only the outer pair, opening before 7:53 and closing after 8:11, marks the passage itself.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B), with Literal keeping the present where the story uses it (8:3-4 "amènent", "disent"); passé composé (R); speech in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé composé for narration at every level

decisions.reason: The French brief for the passage (7:53-8:11), as in 1:19. The passé simple ("s’en alla", "se redressa") is the normal tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé ("est allé", "s’est redressé"). The story tells 8:3-4 in the present; Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does. The imperfect ("écrivait", "sortaient") gives the Greek imperfects of action going on.

records.literal_gloss: At dawn now again he came into the temple, and all the people were coming, and having sat down he was teaching them.

en.L: Now at dawn {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came again into the temple, and all the people were coming [to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], and having sat down {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching them.
en.B: At daybreak {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} returned to the temple courts. All the people kept coming to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sat down and taught them.
en.R: Very early the next morning Jesus went back to the temple area. All the people came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sat down and began to teach them.

es.L: Y al amanecer volvió al templo, y todo el pueblo venía [a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}], y sentándose les enseñaba.
es.B: Al amanecer volvió a los atrios del templo. Todo el pueblo acudía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y se sentó y les enseñaba.
es.R: Muy temprano a la mañana siguiente, Jesús volvió al patio del templo. Toda la gente se acercó a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, así que se sentó y comenzó a enseñarles.

fr.L: Or, à l’aube, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revint au temple, et tout le peuple venait [à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}], et, s’étant assis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les enseignait.
fr.B: Au point du jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} retourna dans la cour du temple. Tout le peuple venait à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’assit et les enseigna.
fr.R: Très tôt le lendemain matin, Jésus est retourné dans la cour du temple. Tous les gens sont venus vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est assis et a commencé à les enseigner.

sw.L: Basi alfajiri alikuja tena hekaluni, na watu wote walikuwa wakija [{{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}], {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaketi akawa anawafundisha.
sw.B: Kulipopambazuka alirudi katika nyua za hekalu. Watu wote waliendelea kumjia, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaketi akawafundisha.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata Yesu alirudi kwenye uwanja wa hekalu. Watu wote walimjia, basi akaketi akaanza kuwafundisha.

vi.L: Nhưng sáng sớm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại vào đền thờ, và cả dân chúng đều đến [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}], rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngồi xuống và giảng dạy họ.
vi.B: Lúc rạng đông, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại sân đền thờ. Cả dân chúng cứ kéo đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngồi xuống dạy dỗ họ.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, Đức Giê-xu trở lại khu đền thờ. Mọi người đều đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngồi xuống và bắt đầu dạy họ.

ko.L: 그런데 새벽에 그분께서 다시 성전에 오셨고, 온 백성이 [그분께] 나아오고 있었다. 그분께서 앉으셔서 그들을 가르치고 계셨다.
ko.B: 날이 밝자 그분께서 다시 성전 뜰로 오셨다. 온 백성이 그분께 계속 몰려오자, 그분께서 앉으셔서 그들을 가르치셨다.
ko.R: 다음 날 아주 이른 아침에 예수께서 다시 성전 뜰로 가셨다. 사람들이 모두 예수께 모여들었다. 그래서 예수께서 앉으셔서 그들을 가르치기 시작하셨다.

pt.L: E de madrugada {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} veio de novo ao templo, e todo o povo vinha [até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}], e, tendo se sentado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os ensinava.
pt.B: Ao raiar do dia, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltou aos pátios do templo. Todo o povo vinha até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se sentou e passou a ensiná-los.
pt.R: Bem cedo na manhã seguinte, Jesus voltou para a área do templo. Todo o povo veio até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se sentou e começou a ensinar as pessoas.

hi.L: और भोर को वे फिर मन्दिर में आए, और सब लोग [उनके पास] आ रहे थे, और वे बैठकर उन्हें सिखा रहे थे।

ru.L: А на рассвете {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} опять пришёл в Храм, и весь народ шёл [к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}], и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, сев, учил их.
ru.B: На рассвете {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} снова пришёл во двор Храма. Весь народ стекался к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сел и учил их.
ru.R: Рано утром на следующий день Иисус снова пришёл во двор Храма. Все люди приходили к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сел и начал их учить.

uk.L: А на світанку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} знову прийшов до храму, і весь народ ішов [до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}], і, сівши, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчав їх.
uk.B: Удосвіта {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} знову прийшов на подвірʼя храму. Увесь народ сходився до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сів і навчав їх.
uk.R: Наступного дня рано-вранці Ісус повернувся на подвірʼя храму. Усі люди приходили до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сів і почав їх навчати.

ja.L: さて、明け方、イエスは再び神殿に来られた。すると民はみな[イエスのもとに]やって来た。そこでイエスは座って、彼らを教えておられた。
ja.B: 夜明けに、イエスは再び神殿の境内に来られた。民衆が皆、イエスのもとにやって来たので、イエスは座って教えられた。
ja.R: 次の日の朝早く、イエスはまた神殿の境内に行かれました。人々がみんなイエスのところに集まって来たので、イエスは座って教え始められました。

decisions.choice: all the people: the ordinary people of the city, gathering in large numbers
decisions.reason: The word used here for "the people" is common in Luke (Luke 21:38) but rare in John, who uses it only twice outside this passage (11:50; 18:14) and usually speaks of "the crowd". "All" describes a large gathering, as people say "the whole town came".

decisions.choice: the temple: the whole temple area, with its courts
decisions.reason: The word means the whole temple area, where teachers met their hearers in the courts and colonnades (10:23), not the sanctuary, which only priests entered.

decisions.choice: he sat down and taught: the usual posture of a teacher
decisions.reason: Jewish teachers sat to teach while their hearers stood or sat around them (Matthew 5:1; 26:55; Luke 4:20; 5:3). The verbs for coming and teaching describe a scene in progress: the people kept arriving and Jesus was teaching when the scribes and Pharisees came in (verse 3).

decisions.choice: temple courts (B); temple area (R)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in John, Balanced and Readable show that the word means the courts of the temple (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: [to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] (L); to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} (B, R); Jesus, the next morning (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says only that the people were coming; to Jesus is clearly meant, since he then teaches them. Readable names Jesus at the start of the scene and says "the next morning", following on from 8:1.

decisions.choice: los atrios del templo (B); el patio del templo (R)
decisions.reason: The 2:14 choice for the whole temple area (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: le temple (L); la cour du temple (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word for the whole temple area with its courts (meaning decision m2), as at 2:14 and 7:14.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans as in English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the reader setting has nothing to change. Respect for Jesus is carried by the subject honorific ("-시-", "께서") and "그분" in the narrative at every level; Jesus speaks in the plain style (해라체) as everywhere in the book. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: "성전" (L); "성전 뜰" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The whole temple area with its courts is meant, where the people gathered; Balanced and Readable say "성전 뜰".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Jesus has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns (እርሱ, እኔ, the verb endings) are written once, with no span.

decisions.choice: ቤተ መቅደስ (temple, L); የቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባይ (the temple courts, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the whole temple area, where Jesus sat and taught the people, not the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: "मन्दिर" (L); "मन्दिर के आँगन" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The whole temple area with its courts (meaning decision m2), as elsewhere in John.

decisions.choice: "в Храм" (L); "во двор Храма" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in John, the word means the whole temple area with its courts (meaning decision m2).

alternatives: "群衆", the word used for the crowd elsewhere in John
decisions.reason: This is the word for "the people", not John's usual word for "the crowd" (m1), so "群衆" is not used here.

source.text: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐν μοιχείᾳ καταλήφθεισαν καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, πειράζοντες Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατελήφθη ἐπ᾿ αὐτοφόρῳ μοιχευομένη ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθοβολεῖσθαι σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;

records.literal_gloss: Bring now the scribes and the Pharisees to him a woman in adultery having been caught, and having stood her in [the] middle \v 4 they say to him, testing: Teacher, this the woman was caught in the very act committing adultery; \v 5 in now the law Moses to us commanded such [women] to be stoned; you therefore what do you say?

en.L: Now the scribes and the Pharisees bring to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a woman caught in adultery, and having stood her in the middle, \v 4 they say to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, testing [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], "Teacher, this woman has been caught in the very act of committing adultery. \v 5 Now in the Law Moses commanded us [that] such [women] be stoned. You, then, what do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say?"
en.B: The scribes and the Pharisees brought to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a woman caught in adultery and made her stand in the middle of the gathering. \v 4 Then they said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to test {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery. \v 5 In the Law, Moses ordered that women like this be stoned. What do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say, then?"
en.R: Then the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees came to Jesus with a woman who had been caught committing adultery. They put her in the middle, in front of everyone. \v 4 They were trying to trap Jesus, so they said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, this woman was caught while she was committing adultery. \v 5 In the Law, Moses told us to kill women like this by throwing stones at them. But what do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say?"

es.L: Entonces los escribas y los fariseos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traen una mujer sorprendida en adulterio, y poniéndola en medio, \v 4 {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dicen, poniéndolo a prueba: «Maestro, esta mujer ha sido sorprendida en el acto mismo de adulterio. \v 5 Y en la ley Moisés nos mandó apedrear a tales [mujeres]. Tú, pues, ¿qué dices?».
es.B: Los escribas y los fariseos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trajeron una mujer sorprendida en adulterio y la pusieron en medio de todos. \v 4 Entonces {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron, para ponerlo a prueba: «Maestro, a esta mujer la sorprendieron en el acto mismo de cometer adulterio. \v 5 En la ley, Moisés mandó apedrear a esta clase de mujeres. ¿Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} qué dices?».
es.R: Entonces los maestros de la ley y los fariseos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevaron a Jesús una mujer que había sido sorprendida cometiendo adulterio. La pusieron en medio, delante de todos. \v 4 Querían tenderle una trampa a Jesús, así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Maestro, a esta mujer la sorprendieron mientras cometía adulterio. \v 5 En la ley, Moisés nos mandó matar a pedradas a mujeres como esta. Pero ¿{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} qué dices?».

fr.L: Or les scribes et les Pharisiens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amènent une femme surprise en adultère, et, l’ayant placée au milieu, \v 4 ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent, pour [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] mettre à l’épreuve : « Maître, cette femme a été surprise en flagrant délit d’adultère. \v 5 Or, dans la Loi, Moïse nous a ordonné de lapider de telles [femmes]. Toi donc, que dis-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ? »
fr.B: Les scribes et les Pharisiens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amenèrent une femme surprise en adultère et la placèrent au milieu de l’assemblée. \v 4 Puis ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent, pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre à l’épreuve : « Maître, cette femme a été surprise en flagrant délit d’adultère. \v 5 Dans la Loi, Moïse a ordonné de lapider ces femmes-là. Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, qu’en dis-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ? »
fr.R: Alors les spécialistes de la Loi et les Pharisiens sont venus trouver Jésus avec une femme qu’on avait surprise en train de commettre un adultère. Ils l’ont placée au milieu, devant tout le monde. \v 4 Ils voulaient piéger Jésus, alors ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Maître, cette femme a été surprise pendant qu’elle commettait un adultère. \v 5 Dans la Loi, Moïse nous a ordonné de tuer ces femmes-là à coups de pierres. Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, qu’est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en dis ? »

sw.L: Basi waandishi na Mafarisayo wanamletea mwanamke aliyekamatwa katika uzinzi, na wakiisha kumsimamisha katikati, \v 4 wanamwambia, wakimjaribu, "Mwalimu, mwanamke huyu amekamatwa akizini, katika tendo lenyewe. \v 5 Basi katika Sheria Musa alituamuru [kwamba] wa namna hii wapigwe mawe. Basi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasemaje?"
sw.B: Waandishi na Mafarisayo walimletea mwanamke aliyekamatwa katika uzinzi, wakamsimamisha katikati ya watu. \v 4 Kisha wakamwambia, ili kumjaribu, "Mwalimu, mwanamke huyu amekamatwa papo hapo akifanya uzinzi. \v 5 Katika Sheria, Musa aliamuru wanawake wa namna hii wapigwe mawe. Basi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasemaje?"
sw.R: Ndipo walimu wa Sheria na Mafarisayo walimletea Yesu mwanamke aliyekamatwa akifanya uzinzi. Walimsimamisha katikati, mbele ya kila mtu. \v 4 Walikuwa wakijaribu kumtega Yesu, basi wakamwambia, "Mwalimu, mwanamke huyu amekamatwa wakati akifanya uzinzi. \v 5 Katika Sheria, Musa alituambia tuwaue wanawake wa namna hii kwa kuwapiga mawe. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasemaje?"

vi.L: Bấy giờ các thầy thông giáo và người Pha-ri-si dẫn đến cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một người phụ nữ bị bắt vì ngoại tình, và đặt chị ấy đứng ở giữa, \v 4 rồi họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để thử [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}]: "Thưa Thầy, người phụ nữ này bị bắt quả tang đang khi phạm tội ngoại tình. \v 5 Trong luật pháp, Môi-se đã truyền cho chúng tôi phải ném đá những [người phụ nữ] như thế. Vậy còn Thầy, Thầy nói sao?"
vi.B: Các thầy thông giáo và người Pha-ri-si dẫn đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một người phụ nữ bị bắt vì ngoại tình, và bắt chị đứng ở giữa đám đông. \v 4 Rồi họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để thử {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, người phụ nữ này bị bắt quả tang đang phạm tội ngoại tình. \v 5 Trong luật pháp, Môi-se đã truyền cho chúng tôi phải ném đá những người phụ nữ như thế. Vậy Thầy nói sao?"
vi.R: Lúc ấy các thầy dạy luật và những người Pha-ri-si dẫn đến với Đức Giê-xu một người phụ nữ bị bắt quả tang đang ngoại tình. Họ bắt chị đứng ở giữa, trước mặt mọi người. \v 4 Họ muốn gài bẫy Đức Giê-xu, nên nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, người phụ nữ này bị bắt ngay lúc đang ngoại tình. \v 5 Trong luật pháp, Môi-se dạy chúng tôi phải ném đá cho chết những người phụ nữ như thế. Còn Thầy, Thầy nói sao?"

ko.L: 그런데 율법학자들과 바리새파 사람들이 간음하다가 붙잡힌 한 여자를 그분께 데리고 온다. 그리고 그 여자를 가운데 세우고, \v 4 그분을 시험하며 그분께 말한다. "선생님, 이 여자가 간음하는 현장에서 붙잡혔습니다. \v 5 그런데 율법에서 모세는 이런 [여자들을] 돌로 치라고 우리에게 명령했습니다. 그러면 선생님은 무엇이라고 말씀하시겠습니까?"
ko.B: 율법학자들과 바리새파 사람들이 간음하다가 붙잡힌 한 여자를 그분께 데리고 와서, 사람들 한가운데 세웠다. \v 4 그리고 그분을 시험하려고 말했다. "선생님, 이 여자가 간음하는 현장에서 붙잡혔습니다. \v 5 모세는 율법에서 이런 여자들은 돌로 쳐 죽이라고 명령했습니다. 그런데 선생님은 어떻게 말씀하시겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그때 율법 선생들과 바리새파 사람들이 간음하다가 붙잡힌 여자 하나를 예수께 데리고 왔다. 그들은 그 여자를 모든 사람 앞, 한가운데에 세웠다. \v 4 그들은 예수님을 함정에 빠뜨리려고 이렇게 말했다. "선생님, 이 여자는 간음하다가 그 자리에서 붙잡혔습니다. \v 5 모세는 율법에서 이런 여자는 돌을 던져 죽이라고 우리에게 말했습니다. 그런데 선생님은 뭐라고 하시겠습니까?"

pt.L: Então os escribas e os fariseus trazem até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} uma mulher apanhada em adultério e, pondo-a no meio, \v 4 dizem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, pondo-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à prova: "Mestre, esta mulher foi apanhada no próprio ato de cometer adultério. \v 5 Ora, na Lei Moisés nos ordenou [que] tais [mulheres] sejam apedrejadas. Tu, pois, que dizes?"
pt.B: Os escribas e os fariseus trouxeram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} uma mulher apanhada em adultério e a fizeram ficar de pé no meio de todos. \v 4 Então, para pô-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} à prova, disseram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: "Mestre, esta mulher foi apanhada em flagrante adultério. \v 5 Na Lei, Moisés mandou apedrejar mulheres assim. E tu, o que dizes?"
pt.R: Então os mestres da Lei e os fariseus trouxeram a Jesus uma mulher que tinha sido pega cometendo adultério. Eles a colocaram no meio, na frente de todos. \v 4 Eles estavam tentando pegar Jesus numa armadilha, por isso disseram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: "Mestre, esta mulher foi pega bem na hora em que estava cometendo adultério. \v 5 Na Lei, Moisés nos mandou matar mulheres assim, atirando pedras nelas. Mas tu, o que dizes?"

am.L: ጸሐፍትና ፈሪሳውያንም በምንዝር የተያዘችን ሴት ወደ እርሱ ያመጣሉ፤ በመካከልም አቁመዋት፣ \v 4 እየፈተኑት እንዲህ ይሉታል፦ «መምህር ሆይ፣ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር እጅ ከፍንጅ ተያዘች። \v 5 በሕግም ሙሴ እንደነዚህ ያሉት [ሴቶች] በድንጋይ እንዲወገሩ አዘዘን፤ አንተስ እንግዲህ ምን ትላለህ?»
am.B: የሕግ መምህራንና ፈሪሳውያን በምንዝር የተያዘች አንዲት ሴት ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ በተሰበሰቡትም መካከል አቆሟት። \v 4 ከዚያም ሊፈትኑት እንዲህ አሉት፦ «መምህር፣ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር እጅ ከፍንጅ ተይዛለች። \v 5 ሙሴ በሕጉ እንደዚህ ያሉ ሴቶች በድንጋይ እንዲወገሩ አዝዞናል። አንተስ ምን ትላለህ?»
am.R: ከዚያም የሕግ መምህራንና ፈሪሳውያን በምንዝር የተያዘች አንዲት ሴት ይዘው ወደ ኢየሱስ መጡ። በሰዉ ሁሉ ፊት በመካከል አቆሟት። \v 4 ኢየሱስን ለማጥመድ ፈልገው እንዲህ አሉት፦ «መምህር፣ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር ተይዛለች። \v 5 ሙሴ በሕጉ እንደዚህ ያሉትን ሴቶች በድንጋይ ወግረን እንድንገድላቸው አዝዞናል። አንተ ግን ምን ትላለህ?»

hi.L: तब शास्त्री और फ़रीसी व्यभिचार में पकड़ी गई एक स्त्री को उनके पास लाते हैं, और उसे बीच में खड़ा करके \v 4 [उन्हें] परखते हुए उनसे कहते हैं, "हे गुरु, यह स्त्री व्यभिचार करते हुए ठीक उसी समय पकड़ी गई है। \v 5 व्यवस्था में मूसा ने हमें आज्ञा दी है कि ऐसी [स्त्रियों] को पत्थरों से मार डाला जाए। तो आप क्या कहते हैं?"
hi.B: व्यवस्था के शिक्षक और फ़रीसी एक स्त्री को उनके पास लाए जो व्यभिचार में पकड़ी गई थी, और उसे सबके बीच में खड़ा कर दिया। \v 4 फिर यीशु को परखने के लिए उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "हे गुरु, यह स्त्री व्यभिचार करते हुए रंगे हाथों पकड़ी गई है। \v 5 व्यवस्था में मूसा ने आज्ञा दी है कि ऐसी स्त्रियों को पत्थरों से मार डाला जाए। तो आप क्या कहते हैं?"
hi.R: तब व्यवस्था के शिक्षक और फ़रीसी एक स्त्री को लेकर यीशु के पास आए, जो व्यभिचार करते हुए पकड़ी गई थी। उन्होंने उसे बीच में, सबके सामने खड़ा कर दिया। \v 4 वे यीशु को फँसाना चाहते थे, इसलिए उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "हे गुरु, यह स्त्री व्यभिचार करते समय पकड़ी गई है। \v 5 व्यवस्था में मूसा ने हमें आज्ञा दी कि ऐसी स्त्रियों को पत्थर मार-मारकर मार डालें। पर आप क्या कहते हैं?"

ru.L: Приводят же книжники и фарисеи к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} женщину, застигнутую в прелюбодеянии, и, поставив её посередине, \v 4 говорят {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, испытывая [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}]: «Учитель, эту женщину поймали прямо в момент прелюбодеяния. \v 5 В Законе же Моисей велел нам таких [женщин] забрасывать камнями. Ты же что говоришь?»
ru.B: Учители Закона и фарисеи привели к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} женщину, застигнутую в прелюбодеянии, и поставили её посреди собравшихся. \v 4 Потом, чтобы испытать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, они сказали {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Учитель, эту женщину застали прямо во время прелюбодеяния. \v 5 Моисей в Законе велел побивать таких женщин камнями. А что скажешь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}?»
ru.R: Тогда учители Закона и фарисеи привели к Иисусу женщину, которую поймали на прелюбодеянии. Они поставили её посередине, перед всеми. \v 4 Они хотели поймать Иисуса в ловушку и поэтому сказали {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Учитель, эту женщину поймали, когда она совершала прелюбодеяние. \v 5 Моисей в Законе велел нам убивать таких женщин, бросая в них камни. А что скажешь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}?»

uk.L: А книжники і фарисеї приводять до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} жінку, спійману на перелюбі, і, поставивши її посередині, \v 4 кажуть {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, випробовуючи [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}]: «Учителю, цю жінку спіймали на самому перелюбі. \v 5 А в Законі Мойсей наказав нам таких [жінок] побивати камінням. А що кажеш {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}?»
uk.B: Учителі Закону й фарисеї привели до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} жінку, спійману на перелюбі, і поставили її посеред зібрання. \v 4 Тоді вони сказали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, щоб випробувати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}: «Учителю, цю жінку спіймали саме тоді, коли вона чинила перелюб. \v 5 Мойсей у Законі наказав побивати таких жінок камінням. А що скажеш {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}?»
uk.R: Тоді учителі Закону й фарисеї привели до Ісуса жінку, яку спіймали на перелюбі. Вони поставили її посередині, перед усіма. \v 4 Вони хотіли заманити Ісуса в пастку, тож сказали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Учителю, цю жінку спіймали тоді, коли вона чинила перелюб. \v 5 У Законі Мойсей наказав нам убивати таких жінок, кидаючи в них камінням. А що скажеш {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}?»

ja.L: さて、律法学者たちとファリサイ派の人々が、姦淫をしているところを捕らえられた女を、イエスのもとに連れて来る。そして[彼女を]真ん中に立たせて、\v 4 イエスを試しながら言う。「先生、この女は姦淫の現場で捕らえられました。\v 5 さて、律法の中でモーセは、このような[女たち]を石で打つようにと、わたしたちに命じました。では、あなたは何と言われますか？」
ja.B: 律法学者たちとファリサイ派の人々が、姦淫をしているところを捕らえられた女をイエスのもとに連れて来て、人々の真ん中に立たせた。\v 4 そして、イエスを試そうとして言った。「先生、この女は姦淫の現場で捕らえられました。\v 5 律法の中で、モーセはこういう女を石で打ち殺すように命じています。では、あなたは何とおっしゃいますか？」
ja.R: そこへ、律法学者たちとファリサイ派の人々が、姦淫をしているところを捕まった女の人を連れて来ました。そして、みんなの前で、その人を真ん中に立たせました。\v 4 彼らはイエスをわなにかけようとして、こう言いました。「先生、この女は姦淫をしている最中に捕まりました。\v 5 律法の中で、モーセは、こういう女は石を投げつけて殺すようにと、わたしたちに命じています。でも、あなたは何とおっしゃいますか？」

decisions.choice: the scribes: experts who copied, taught and applied the Law of Moses
decisions.reason: The word first meant a writer or clerk, but in the Gospels it names the experts in the Law, who often appear together with the Pharisees (Mark 2:16; Luke 5:21, 30). This is the only place where they appear in John, which elsewhere speaks of the chief priests and the Pharisees (7:32, 45).

decisions.choice: the Law commanded death for adultery, for the man as well as the woman
alternatives: the Law commanded stoning for the woman only
decisions.reason: The Law of Moses says that when a man commits adultery with another man's wife, both the man and the woman are to be put to death (Leviticus 20:10; Deuteronomy 22:22). Where the woman was engaged to be married, it names stoning for both of them (Deuteronomy 22:23-24); for a married woman the method is not stated. The accusers speak only of "such women", and they bring the woman but not the man, though they claim she was caught in the act. The story does not say why the man is missing, and it does not say whether the woman was married or engaged.

decisions.choice: in the very act: caught while the act was taking place
decisions.reason: The phrase means "caught red-handed". The Law required two or three witnesses before anyone was put to death (Deuteronomy 17:6; 19:15), and the accusers stress that the facts are not in doubt.

decisions.choice: testing: in verse 4, and again in verse 6 (SBLGNT)
alternatives: the word about testing in verse 4 only
the word about testing in verse 6 only
decisions.reason: The manuscripts of this passage differ a good deal in wording. The SBLGNT has the word "testing" both here and in verse 6; some manuscripts have it in only one of the two places, and some put the whole comment about their aim in verse 4. The meaning is the same either way. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: you, then: an emphatic "you", set against Moses
alternatives: a plain question with no contrast
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out, which the Greek does not need, and it stands first: Moses has spoken; what do you say? The question invites Jesus to say something that can be set against the Law.

decisions.choice: brought ... said (B, R)
decisions.reason: The historic present: the story tells past events with present-tense verbs ("they bring", "they say"), a lively way of telling a story. Literal keeps the present; Balanced and Readable use the past, which is normal in English narrative. This note covers the passage.

decisions.choice: the teachers of the Law
decisions.reason: "Scribes" today suggests people who only copy; Readable says what they were (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: [that] such [women] be stoned (L); kill women like this by throwing stones at them (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "such" in the feminine, so "women" is understood; Literal shows it in brackets. Readable says plainly what stoning was: a way of putting a person to death.

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal; pretérito at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in John: Literal keeps John's present ("dice", "ven"); Balanced and Readable use the pretérito. This applies throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: los escribas (L, B); los maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "escribas" today suggests copyists; Readable says what they were (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}
decisions.reason: The emphatic "tú", set against Moses (meaning decision m5), is a stressed pronoun for Christ and takes the setting in Balanced and Readable. In Literal it opens the sentence ("Tú, pues") and is written plain, as the book-wide rule says (John 1:1).

decisions.choice: les scribes (L, B); les spécialistes de la Loi (R)
decisions.reason: "Scribe" today suggests a copyist; Readable says what they were (meaning decision m1). "Maîtres de la Loi" would clash with "Maître", the address to Jesus in the next breath, and "docteurs" now means physicians.

decisions.choice: en flagrant délit
decisions.reason: French has a legal idiom for exactly this, caught while the act was taking place (meaning decision m3); Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: waandishi (L, B); walimu wa Sheria (R)
alternatives: walimu wa sheria at every level
decisions.reason: "Waandishi" (writers) is the established Swahili name for the scribes, the experts who copied, taught and applied the Law. Readable says what they did, "walimu wa Sheria", as the English Readable says "teachers of the Law".

decisions.choice: "율법학자들" (L, B); "율법 선생들" (R)
decisions.reason: "서기관" is the traditional Protestant word but suggests a clerk to a modern reader; these men were experts who taught and applied the Law of Moses. The guide does not list the word; a reviewer should confirm it for the whole book.

decisions.choice: The accusers address Jesus in the formal polite style (합쇼체: "선생님", "말씀하시겠습니까"); the historic present is kept at Literal ("데리고 온다", "말한다")
decisions.reason: Their courtesy is part of the trap, so the scene keeps the guide's default for people speaking to Jesus. Literal keeps John's present tense for vividness; Balanced and Readable use the past.

decisions.choice: thầy thông giáo (L, B); thầy dạy luật (R)
decisions.reason: "thầy thông giáo" is the established Protestant term for the scribes ("kinh sư" is the Catholic one); Readable says what they did.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy", and "Thầy" for "you", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: They address him by the title "Teacher", and Vietnamese goes on using the title as the pronoun. As the guide sets, "Thầy" is a noun of address, always capitalised, and takes no span where the English has "you" under the setting.

decisions.choice: ጸሐፍት (scribes, L); የሕግ መምህራን (teachers of the Law, B, R)
decisions.reason: They were teachers and interpreters of the Law, not copyists, and ጸሐፍት reads as 'writers' to most readers today; Balanced follows the Amharic style table here rather than the English Balanced.

decisions.choice: ያመጣሉ ... ይሉታል (bring ... say, L); አመጡ ... አሉት (brought ... said, B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the historic present of the Greek; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past. This holds for the passage.

decisions.choice: "शास्त्री" (L); "व्यवस्था के शिक्षक" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's words for the scribes: they were teachers of the Law, not copyists (meaning decision m1).

alternatives: the past tense at Literal too
decisions.reason: The story uses the present tense for past events. Literal keeps the present; Balanced and Readable use the past, as Hindi narrative does.

decisions.choice: "हे गुरु" and "आप" from the accusers
decisions.reason: Opponents too address Jesus as a teacher, with "आप" (style guide 4 and 6), even while they test him.

decisions.choice: "книжники" (L); "учители Закона" (B, R)
decisions.reason: They were experts who taught and applied the Law of Moses, not copyists (meaning decision m1; style guide, section 6).

decisions.choice: "Приводят", "говорят" (L); "привели", "сказали" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the historic present of the story; Balanced and Readable use the past, as Russian stories normally do.

decisions.choice: "Ты же что говоришь?" (L); "А что скажешь ты?" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The "you" is emphatic, set against Moses (meaning decision m5); Literal puts it first, as the Greek does, and Balanced and Readable put it last, where Russian stresses it.

decisions.choice: "книжники" (L); "учителі Закону" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets: the scribes were experts who taught and applied the Law (meaning decision m1), not copyists, which "книжники" can suggest to a modern reader.

decisions.choice: "А що кажеш ти?" with the pronoun last
decisions.reason: The emphatic Greek "you", set against Moses (meaning decision m5), is carried in Ukrainian by putting the pronoun at the end, where the stress falls.

decisions.choice: "連れて来る", "言う" (L); "連れて来た", "言った" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The historic present: Literal keeps the present, Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past. This covers the passage.

decisions.choice: the accusers speak politely to Jesus ("先生", "ました", "言われますか" / "おっしゃいますか")
decisions.reason: They address him as Teacher and put a formal question to him in public; the courtesy is part of the trap (m5, and m1 at 8:6). "律法学者" is the Japanese brief's word for the scribes at every level.

decisions.choice: testing: trying to trap him into saying something wrong
decisions.reason: The same verb can mean a fair test (6:6), but here, as when Jesus' opponents question him in the other Gospels (Mark 10:2; 12:15), the aim is to catch him out. The rest of the sentence says so.

decisions.choice: have to accuse: have grounds on which to bring a charge
decisions.reason: "To have" with a verb means to have the means or occasion to do it. They wanted something Jesus said that they could use as a charge against him.

decisions.choice: a trap: either answer could be used against him
alternatives: a sincere question about the Law
decisions.reason: The story does not explain the trap, but its outline is clear. If Jesus said that the woman should go free, they could accuse him of setting aside the Law of Moses. If he said that she should be stoned, he would go against the mercy he was known for, and he could also be accused before the Roman governor, since under Roman rule the Jewish authorities were not allowed to put anyone to death on their own (18:31). Whether the second danger was in view depends on how strictly that rule was kept in practice, which is not certain.

decisions.choice: [grounds] (L); a reason to bring charges (R)
alternatives: so that they might have to accuse him
decisions.reason: "Have to accuse" is not English; Literal supplies "grounds" in brackets (meaning decision m2). Readable names the testing as a trap (m1).

decisions.choice: tener de qué acusarlo, no supplied word
decisions.reason: Spanish "tener de qué" is the same idiom as the Greek (meaning decision m2), so Literal needs no bracket.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

records.literal_gloss: But Jesus down having stooped with the finger was writing on the ground.

en.L: But Jesus, having stooped down, was writing with [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] finger on the ground.
en.B: But Jesus bent down and, with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} finger, began writing on the ground.
en.R: But Jesus bent over and used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} finger to write on the ground.

es.L: Pero Jesús, inclinándose, escribía con el dedo en la tierra.
es.B: Pero Jesús se inclinó y se puso a escribir con el dedo en la tierra.
es.R: Pero Jesús se agachó y escribió en el suelo con el dedo.

fr.L: Mais Jésus, s’étant baissé, écrivait du doigt sur le sol.
fr.B: Mais Jésus se baissa et se mit à écrire avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} doigt sur le sol.
fr.R: Mais Jésus s’est penché et a écrit sur le sol avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} doigt.

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akiinama chini, alikuwa akiandika ardhini kwa kidole [{{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}].
sw.B: Lakini Yesu aliinama, akaanza kuandika ardhini kwa kidole {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}.
sw.R: Lakini Yesu aliinama, akatumia kidole {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kuandika ardhini.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cúi xuống, lấy ngón tay viết trên đất.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cúi xuống và bắt đầu lấy ngón tay viết trên đất.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu cúi xuống, dùng ngón tay viết trên mặt đất.

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서는 몸을 아래로 굽히시고 손가락으로 땅에 쓰고 계셨다.
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서는 몸을 굽히시고 손가락으로 땅에 무엇인가를 쓰기 시작하셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서는 몸을 숙이시고 손가락으로 땅에 무엇인가를 쓰셨다.

pt.L: Mas Jesus, tendo se abaixado, escrevia com o [{{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}}] dedo no chão.
pt.B: Mas Jesus se abaixou e começou a escrever no chão com o dedo.
pt.R: Mas Jesus se abaixou e escreveu no chão com o dedo.

am.L: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ ታች ጎንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በመሬት ላይ ይጽፍ ነበር።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ግን ጎንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ መሬት ላይ ይጽፍ ጀመር።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ግን ጎንበስ አለና በጣቱ መሬት ላይ ጻፈ።

hi.L: पर यीशु झुककर [अपनी] उँगली से भूमि पर लिख रहे थे।
hi.B: पर यीशु झुके और अपनी उँगली से ज़मीन पर लिखने लगे।
hi.R: पर यीशु नीचे झुके और अपनी उँगली से ज़मीन पर लिखा।

ru.L: Но Иисус, наклонившись вниз, писал пальцем по земле.
ru.B: Но Иисус наклонился и начал писать пальцем на земле.
ru.R: Но Иисус нагнулся и стал писать пальцем на земле.

uk.L: А Ісус, нахилившись донизу, писав пальцем на землі.
uk.B: Але Ісус нахилився і почав писати пальцем на землі.
uk.R: Але Ісус нахилився і став писати пальцем на землі.

ja.L: しかし、イエスはかがみ込んで、指で地面に書いておられた。
ja.B: しかしイエスは身をかがめて、指で地面に書き始められた。
ja.R: でも、イエスは身をかがめて、指で地面に書かれました。

decisions.choice: was writing: forming letters or words; what he wrote is not said
alternatives: writing the sins of the accusers
decisions.reason: The verb means to write. The story does not say what Jesus wrote, and nothing in it depends on the words; what matters is that he does not answer at once. Guesses about the words go beyond the text.

decisions.choice: no sure allusion
alternatives: an echo of Jeremiah 17:13, where those who turn away from the LORD are "written in the earth"
an echo of the Law written by "the finger of God" (Exodus 31:18)
decisions.reason: Some readers hear an echo of Jeremiah 17:13 or of the tablets of the Law written by the finger of God. The story itself points to neither, so the link is possible but uncertain.

decisions.choice: was writing: the imperfect describes action going on while they kept asking
decisions.reason: The tense pictures Jesus writing as the questions continued (verse 7).

decisions.choice: began writing
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the writing went on (meaning decision m3); Readable keeps the plain past.

decisions.choice: se puso a escribir
decisions.reason: Shows that the writing went on (meaning decision m3). Spanish says "el dedo", so no possessive is needed.

decisions.choice: du doigt (L), with no possessive
decisions.reason: The Greek says "with the finger". French "écrire du doigt" is natural with the article alone, so Literal needs no supplied possessive and no setting; Balanced and Readable say "avec son doigt", with the deity_pronoun setting as in English.

source.text: μὴ προσποιούμενος ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνακύψας εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἐπ᾿ αὐτὴν τὸν λίθον βαλέτω καὶ πάλιν κάτω κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

records.literal_gloss: not paying attention. \v 7 As now they continued asking him, having straightened up he said to them, The sinless [one] of you first at her the stone let him throw. \v 8 And again down having stooped he was writing on the ground.

en.L: [He was] not paying attention. \v 7 But as they kept on asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, having straightened up, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Let the sinless one among you be first to throw the stone at her." \v 8 And again having stooped down, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was writing on the ground.
en.B: He took no notice of them. \v 7 As they went on asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stood up straight and said to them, "Whoever among you has no sin, let that person throw the first stone at her." \v 8 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent down again and went on writing on the ground.
en.R: Jesus did not pay attention to them. \v 7 But they kept asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} questions. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stood up and spoke to them. "Any one of you who has never sinned may throw the first stone at her." \v 8 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent down again and kept writing on the ground.

es.L: No les prestaba atención. \v 7 Y como insistían en preguntarle, se enderezó y les dijo: «El que de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} esté sin pecado, sea el primero en arrojarle la piedra». \v 8 E inclinándose de nuevo, escribía en la tierra.
es.B: No les hizo caso. \v 7 Como seguían preguntándole, se enderezó y les dijo: «Aquel de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que no tenga pecado, que sea el primero en tirarle una piedra». \v 8 Luego se inclinó otra vez y siguió escribiendo en la tierra.
es.R: Jesús no les hizo caso. \v 7 Pero ellos seguían haciéndole preguntas. Entonces se enderezó y les dijo: «Cualquiera de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que nunca haya pecado puede tirarle la primera piedra». \v 8 Luego volvió a agacharse y siguió escribiendo en el suelo.

fr.L: [Il] ne prêtait pas attention. \v 7 Mais comme ils continuaient à {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interroger, s’étant redressé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Que celui d’entre vous qui est sans péché soit le premier à lancer la pierre contre elle. » \v 8 Et, s’étant de nouveau baissé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écrivait sur le sol.
fr.B: Il ne leur prêta aucune attention. \v 7 Comme ils continuaient à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} questionner, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se redressa et leur dit : « Que celui d’entre vous qui n’a pas de péché soit le premier à lui lancer une pierre. » \v 8 Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se baissa de nouveau et continua d’écrire sur le sol.
fr.R: Jésus ne faisait pas attention à eux. \v 7 Mais ils continuaient à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} poser des questions. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est redressé et leur a parlé : « Si l’un de vous n’a jamais péché, qu’il lance la première pierre contre elle. » \v 8 Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est de nouveau penché et a continué à écrire sur le sol.

sw.L: [Hakuwa] akiwajali. \v 7 Lakini walipoendelea kumwuliza, akainuka, akawaambia, "Aliye kati yenu bila dhambi amtupie jiwe kwanza." \v 8 Na akiinama tena, alikuwa akiandika ardhini.
sw.B: Hakuwajali. \v 7 Walipoendelea kumwuliza, alisimama wima akawaambia, "Mtu yeyote kati yenu ambaye hana dhambi, yeye awe wa kwanza kumtupia jiwe." \v 8 Kisha akainama tena, akaendelea kuandika ardhini.
sw.R: Yesu hakuwajali. \v 7 Lakini waliendelea kumwuliza maswali. Basi akasimama akasema nao. "Yeyote kati yenu ambaye hajawahi kutenda dhambi anaweza kumtupia jiwe la kwanza." \v 8 Kisha akainama tena, akaendelea kuandika ardhini.

vi.L: [Ngài] không để ý. \v 7 Nhưng khi họ cứ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng thẳng lên và nói với họ: "Ai trong các người không có tội, hãy là người đầu tiên ném hòn đá vào chị ấy." \v 8 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại cúi xuống viết trên đất.
vi.B: Ngài không để ý đến họ. \v 7 Khi họ cứ tiếp tục hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng thẳng lên và nói với họ: "Ai trong các người không có tội, người ấy hãy ném đá chị ấy trước đi." \v 8 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại cúi xuống và tiếp tục viết trên đất.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu không để ý đến họ. \v 7 Nhưng họ cứ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng lên và nói với họ: "Ai trong các người chưa từng phạm tội thì có thể ném hòn đá đầu tiên vào chị ấy." \v 8 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại cúi xuống và tiếp tục viết trên đất.

ko.L: [그분은] 개의치 않으셨다. \v 7 그러나 그들이 그분께 계속 묻자, 그분께서 몸을 일으키시고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 죄 없는 사람이 먼저 그 여자에게 돌을 던져라." \v 8 그리고 다시 몸을 아래로 굽히시고 땅에 쓰고 계셨다.
ko.B: 그분은 그들을 상대하지 않으셨다. \v 7 그들이 계속 묻자, 그분께서 몸을 펴고 일어나셔서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 죄가 없는 사람이 있으면, 그 사람이 먼저 이 여자에게 돌을 던져라." \v 8 그리고 다시 몸을 굽히시고 계속해서 땅에 쓰셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 그들에게 신경 쓰지 않으셨다. \v 7 그러나 그들은 예수님께 계속 물었다. 그러자 예수께서 일어나셔서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 한 번도 죄를 지은 적이 없는 사람은 누구든지 이 여자에게 첫 돌을 던져도 좋다." \v 8 그러고는 다시 몸을 굽히시고 계속 땅에 쓰셨다.

pt.L: [Ele] não prestava atenção. \v 7 Mas, como continuavam a {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntar, tendo se endireitado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Quem dentre vocês [está] sem pecado seja o primeiro a lançar a pedra contra ela." \v 8 E, abaixando-se de novo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escrevia no chão.
pt.B: Ele não lhes deu atenção. \v 7 Como continuavam a {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} fazer perguntas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se endireitou e lhes disse: "Quem de vocês não tem pecado atire nela a primeira pedra." \v 8 Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se abaixou de novo e continuou escrevendo no chão.
pt.R: Jesus não deu atenção a eles. \v 7 Mas eles continuavam fazendo perguntas a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se levantou e falou com eles: "Quem de vocês nunca pecou pode atirar nela a primeira pedra." \v 8 Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se abaixou de novo e continuou escrevendo no chão.

am.L: [እርሱም] ልብ አላለም። \v 7 እነርሱም መጠየቃቸውን በቀጠሉ ጊዜ ቀና ብሎ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ከእናንተ ኃጢአት የሌለበት አስቀድሞ በእርሷ ላይ ድንጋዩን ይጣል።» \v 8 እንደ ገናም ወደ ታች ጎንበስ ብሎ በመሬት ላይ ይጽፍ ነበር።
am.B: እርሱም ትኩረት አልሰጣቸውም። \v 7 እነርሱ ግን መጠየቃቸውን በቀጠሉ ጊዜ ቀና ብሎ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ከእናንተ መካከል ኃጢአት የሌለበት ቢኖር እርሱ በመጀመሪያ ድንጋይ ይወርውርባት።» \v 8 ከዚያም እንደ ገና ጎንበስ ብሎ መሬት ላይ መጻፉን ቀጠለ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ግን ትኩረት አልሰጣቸውም። \v 7 እነርሱ ግን ጥያቄ ማቅረባቸውን ቀጠሉ። ስለዚህ ቀና ብሎ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ከእናንተ መካከል ኃጢአት ሠርቶ የማያውቅ ሰው ካለ፣ በመጀመሪያ እርሱ ድንጋይ ይወርውርባት።» \v 8 ከዚያም እንደ ገና ጎንበስ ብሎ መሬት ላይ መጻፉን ቀጠለ።

hi.L: [यीशु] ध्यान नहीं दे रहे थे। \v 7 पर जब वे उनसे पूछते ही रहे, तो उन्होंने सीधे होकर उनसे कहा, "तुममें जो निष्पाप हो, वही पहले उस पर पत्थर मारे।" \v 8 और फिर झुककर वे भूमि पर लिख रहे थे।
hi.B: यीशु ने उन पर कोई ध्यान नहीं दिया। \v 7 जब वे उनसे बार-बार पूछते रहे, तो वे सीधे खड़े हुए और उनसे कहा, "तुममें से जिसने कोई पाप न किया हो, वही उस पर पहला पत्थर फेंके।" \v 8 फिर वे दोबारा झुककर ज़मीन पर लिखते रहे।
hi.R: यीशु ने उन पर ध्यान नहीं दिया। \v 7 पर वे उनसे सवाल पूछते रहे। तब यीशु सीधे खड़े हुए और उनसे बोले। "तुममें से जिसने कभी पाप नहीं किया, वह उस पर पहला पत्थर फेंक सकता है।" \v 8 फिर वे दोबारा झुके और ज़मीन पर लिखते रहे।

ru.L: [Он] не обращал внимания. \v 7 Когда же они продолжали спрашивать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, выпрямившись, сказал им: «Безгрешный из вас пусть первым бросит в неё камень.» \v 8 И, снова наклонившись вниз, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} писал на земле.
ru.B: Он не обращал на них внимания. \v 7 Но так как они продолжали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} спрашивать, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выпрямился и сказал им: «Тот из вас, кто без греха, пусть первым бросит в неё камень.» \v 8 Потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} снова наклонился и продолжал писать на земле.
ru.R: Иисус не обращал на них внимания. \v 7 Но они всё задавали {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} вопросы. Тогда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выпрямился и заговорил с ними: «Кто из вас никогда не грешил, тот может первым бросить в неё камень.» \v 8 Потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} снова нагнулся и продолжал писать на земле.

uk.L: Не зважаючи [на них]. \v 7 А коли вони не переставали питати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}, випроставшись, сказав їм: «Безгрішний з вас нехай перший кине на неї камінь.» \v 8 І знову, нахилившись донизу, писав на землі.
uk.B: Він не звертав на них уваги. \v 7 Коли вони й далі допитувалися, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} випростався і сказав їм: «Хто з вас без гріха, той нехай першим кине в неї камінь.» \v 8 Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} знову нахилився і далі писав на землі.
uk.R: Ісус не звертав на них уваги. \v 7 Але вони все ставили {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} запитання. Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підвівся і заговорив до них. «Хто з вас ніколи не грішив, може першим кинути в неї камінь.» \v 8 Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} знову нахилився і писав далі на землі.

ja.L: 気に留めずに[おられた]。\v 7 しかし、彼らがしつこく問い続けるので、イエスは身を起こして彼らに言われた。「あなたがたのうちで罪のない者が、最初に彼女に石を投げるがよい。」\v 8 そして再び身をかがめて、地面に書いておられた。
ja.B: イエスは彼らを相手にされなかった。\v 7 しかし、彼らがなおも問い続けるので、イエスは身を起こして言われた。「あなたがたの中で罪のない者が、まず、この女に石を投げなさい。」\v 8 そして、再び身をかがめて、地面に書き続けられた。
ja.R: イエスは彼らに取り合われませんでした。\v 7 でも、彼らはしつこく質問し続けました。そこでイエスは体を起こして、彼らに言われました。「あなたたちの中で、一度も罪を犯したことのない人が、最初にこの女に石を投げなさい。」\v 8 そして、また身をかがめて、地面に書き続けられました。

decisions.choice: the two words for "not paying attention" open this record, following the token data
alternatives: they close the previous sentence, as the SBLGNT prints them: "he was writing on the ground, not paying attention"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT prints a full stop after these two words, so that they end verse 6 and describe Jesus as he wrote. The token data that these records follow puts the full stop before them, so they stand at the start of this sentence. The meaning does not change: either way Jesus is writing and does not respond to the questions. These two words are also missing from many manuscripts of the passage; others add to them, "as though he did not hear". A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: not paying attention: taking no notice of them
alternatives: as though he did not hear them
decisions.reason: The verb means to act as if or to take notice of something. With "not" it says that Jesus did not respond to them, but kept on writing.

decisions.choice: the sinless one among you: anyone of them who has not sinned
alternatives: one who has not committed this particular sin
one who is not guilty in this case
decisions.reason: The word means "without sin" in general. Jesus does not deny the Law or the woman's guilt; he turns the question to the accusers themselves. The words are masculine, since the accusers in front of him are men, but the principle he states is a general one.

decisions.choice: the stone, first: the first stone of an execution, thrown by the witnesses
decisions.reason: The Law said that at an execution "the hand of the witnesses" was to be first against the condemned person, and then the hand of all the people (Deuteronomy 17:7). The article points to the stone that begins the stoning. Jesus asks those who claim to be witnesses to take that first step, if they are without sin themselves.

decisions.choice: [He was] (L); He took no notice of them (B); Jesus did not pay attention to them (R)
decisions.reason: The two words are a participle with no main verb in this sentence (meaning decision m1), so every level makes them a short sentence of their own; Literal shows the supplied words in brackets.

decisions.choice: the sinless one among you (L); whoever among you has no sin, let that person (B); any one of you who has never sinned (R)
alternatives: let him who is without sin
he who is without sin among you, let him
decisions.reason: The Greek has a third-person command, "let him throw". English can carry it without a pronoun, so every level states the general principle (meaning decision m3) in words that already include everyone; no reader setting is needed.

decisions.choice: No les prestaba atención, no supplied subject
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, so Literal needs no bracketed "[He was]" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: el que de ustedes esté sin pecado (L); aquel de ustedes que no tenga pecado (B); cualquiera de ustedes que nunca haya pecado (R)
decisions.reason: The third-person command carries over into Spanish with "el que" or "cualquiera", which are general, so no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: Que celui d’entre vous qui ... soit le premier (L, B); Si l’un de vous ..., qu’il (R): no gender setting
alternatives: Que la personne parmi vous qui ...
decisions.reason: The Greek third-person command states a general principle (meaning decision m3). French "celui d’entre vous qui" and "l’un de vous" are the ordinary general forms, read as "any of you", so, as in English, no reader setting is needed; "la personne parmi vous" would sound contrived in a sharp saying.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "죄 없는 사람"
alternatives: a gender setting span as in English
decisions.reason: "사람" already includes everyone and Korean needs no pronoun, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the accusers; "chị ấy" for the woman
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to opponents as "các người", as the guide sets. For the woman Vietnamese must choose an age word: "chị" fits an adult woman who is not old and is respectful without distance; "người phụ nữ" rather than "người đàn bà" avoids the slight coldness the older word has today.

decisions.choice: Quem dentre vocês [está] sem pecado (L); Quem de vocês não tem pecado (B); Quem de vocês nunca pecou (R)
alternatives: Aquele que dentre vocês estiver sem pecado
decisions.reason: "Quem" states the general principle (meaning decision m3) in a word that already includes anyone, as the English does without a pronoun, so no gender setting is needed. "Atirar a primeira pedra" is an everyday Portuguese saying that comes from this verse, and Balanced and Readable use it.

decisions.choice: "[यीशु]" as the subject of "not paying attention"
decisions.reason: The participle has no main verb in this sentence (meaning decision m1); Literal supplies the subject in brackets, naming Jesus because the honorific "वे" would read as the accusers.

decisions.choice: "Безгрешный из вас пусть первым бросит" (L); "Тот из вас, кто без греха" (B); "Кто из вас никогда не грешил" (R)
decisions.reason: The Russian third-person command "пусть бросит" carries the Greek form without a pronoun, so no gender setting is needed; every level states the general principle (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "罪のない者" (L, B); "一度も罪を犯したことのない人" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The principle is a general one (m3), and "者" and "人" include everyone, so no setting is needed. Literal gives the third-person command as "投げるがよい"; Balanced and Readable make it a plain command.

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες καὶ ὑπὸ τῆς συνειδήσεως ἐλεγχόμενοι ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθ᾿ εἷς ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος, ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα.

records.literal_gloss: They now having heard and by the conscience being convicted were going out one by one, having begun from the older ones, and was left alone Jesus, and the woman in [the] middle being.

en.L: And having heard [it] and being convicted by [their] conscience, they went out one by one, beginning from the older ones; and Jesus was left alone, and the woman, being in the middle.
en.B: When they heard this, convicted by their conscience, they left one after another, the oldest first. Jesus was left by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and the woman was still there in the middle.
en.R: When they heard what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, their consciences told them that they were guilty. One by one they went away, starting with the oldest. In the end the accusers were all gone. Jesus was left with the woman, who was still standing in the middle where they had put her.

es.L: Y al oír[lo], acusados por la conciencia, salían uno a uno, comenzando por los más viejos; y quedó Jesús solo, y la mujer, que estaba en medio.
es.B: Al oír esto, acusados por su conciencia, se fueron uno tras otro, comenzando por los más viejos. Jesús se quedó solo, y la mujer seguía allí en medio.
es.R: Cuando oyeron lo que dijo, su conciencia les dijo que eran culpables. Uno por uno se fueron, empezando por los más viejos. Al final, todos los acusadores se habían ido. Jesús se quedó con la mujer, que seguía de pie en medio, donde la habían puesto.

fr.L: Et eux, ayant entendu [cela] et accusés par [leur] conscience, sortaient un à un, en commençant par les plus âgés ; et Jésus fut laissé seul, et la femme qui était au milieu.
fr.B: En entendant cela, et accusés par leur conscience, ils s’en allèrent l’un après l’autre, les plus âgés d’abord. Jésus resta seul, et la femme était toujours là, au milieu.
fr.R: Quand ils ont entendu ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit, leur conscience leur a montré qu’ils étaient coupables. Ils sont partis un par un, en commençant par les plus âgés. À la fin, tous les accusateurs étaient partis. Jésus est resté avec la femme, qui était toujours debout au milieu, là où ils l’avaient placée.

sw.L: Na waliposikia [hayo], wakihukumiwa na dhamiri [zao], walitoka mmoja mmoja, wakianzia kwa wazee; na Yesu akabaki peke yake, na yule mwanamke, akiwa katikati.
sw.B: Waliposikia hivyo, dhamiri zao zikiwashtaki, waliondoka mmoja baada ya mwingine, wazee wakitangulia. Yesu akabaki peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na yule mwanamke alikuwa bado pale katikati.
sw.R: Waliposikia aliyosema, dhamiri zao ziliwaambia kwamba walikuwa na hatia. Mmoja mmoja waliondoka, wakianzia na wazee. Mwishowe washtaki wote walikuwa wameondoka. Yesu akabaki na yule mwanamke, ambaye alikuwa bado amesimama katikati pale walipokuwa wamemweka.

vi.L: Nghe [vậy] và bị lương tâm cáo trách, họ lần lượt từng người một đi ra, bắt đầu từ những người lớn tuổi; và chỉ còn lại một mình Đức Giê-xu, với người phụ nữ vẫn đứng ở giữa.
vi.B: Khi nghe điều ấy, bị lương tâm cáo trách, họ lần lượt bỏ đi, những người già nhất đi trước. Chỉ còn lại một mình Đức Giê-xu, và người phụ nữ vẫn đứng ở giữa.
vi.R: Khi nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói vậy, lương tâm họ cho họ biết rằng họ có tội. Họ lần lượt từng người một bỏ đi, bắt đầu từ người già nhất. Cuối cùng những người tố cáo đều đi hết. Chỉ còn Đức Giê-xu với người phụ nữ, chị vẫn đứng ở giữa, nơi họ đã đặt chị.

ko.L: 그런데 그들은 [이 말을] 듣고 양심의 책망을 받아, 나이 많은 이들부터 시작하여 하나씩 하나씩 나갔다. 그리고 예수께서 홀로 남으셨고, 여자는 가운데 있었다.
ko.B: 그들은 이 말씀을 듣고 양심에 찔려서, 나이 많은 사람부터 시작하여 하나둘씩 떠나갔다. 예수께서 홀로 남으셨고, 그 여자는 여전히 가운데 서 있었다.
ko.R: 그들은 예수님의 말씀을 듣고, 양심에 비추어 자기들도 죄가 있다는 것을 깨달았다. 그래서 가장 나이 많은 사람부터 한 사람씩 떠나갔다. 마침내 고발하던 사람들이 다 가 버렸다. 예수님과 그 여자만 남았다. 그 여자는 그들이 세워 놓은 한가운데에 그대로 서 있었다.

pt.L: E, tendo ouvido [isso] e sendo acusados pela [própria] consciência, saíam um por um, começando pelos mais velhos; e ficou só Jesus, e a mulher, que estava no meio.
pt.B: Quando ouviram isso, acusados pela própria consciência, foram saindo um após o outro, começando pelos mais velhos. Jesus ficou sozinho, e a mulher continuava ali no meio.
pt.R: Quando ouviram o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse, a consciência deles mostrou que eram culpados. Eles foram embora um por um, começando pelos mais velhos. No fim, todos os acusadores tinham ido embora. Jesus ficou com a mulher, que ainda estava de pé no meio, onde eles a tinham colocado.

am.L: እነርሱም ሰምተው በኅሊናቸውም ተወቅሰው ከሽማግሌዎቹ ጀምረው አንድ በአንድ ይወጡ ነበር፤ ኢየሱስም ብቻውን ቀረ፣ ሴቲቱም በመካከል ሆና።
am.B: ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ኅሊናቸው ወቀሳቸውና በዕድሜ ከሚበልጡት ጀምረው አንድ በአንድ ወጡ። ኢየሱስ ብቻውን ቀረ፤ ሴቲቱም አሁንም በመካከል ቆማ ነበር።
am.R: ኢየሱስ የተናገረውን በሰሙ ጊዜ ኅሊናቸው በደለኞች መሆናቸውን ነገራቸው። ከትልልቆቹ ጀምረው አንድ በአንድ ሄዱ። በመጨረሻ ከሳሾቹ ሁሉ ሄደው አለቁ። ኢየሱስ ከሴቲቱ ጋር ብቻውን ቀረ፤ እርሷም ባቆሟት ቦታ በመካከል እንደ ቆመች ነበር።

hi.L: और वे [यह] सुनकर और [अपने] विवेक से दोषी ठहरकर, बड़ों से आरंभ करके एक-एक करके निकलने लगे; और यीशु अकेले रह गए, और वह स्त्री जो बीच में थी।
hi.B: यह सुनकर, अपने विवेक से दोषी ठहरकर, वे सबसे बूढ़ों से शुरू करके एक-एक करके चले गए। यीशु अकेले रह गए, और वह स्त्री अब भी बीच में खड़ी थी।
hi.R: जब उन्होंने यीशु की बात सुनी, तो उनके मन ने उन्हें बताया कि वे दोषी हैं। वे सबसे बूढ़े से शुरू होकर एक-एक करके चले गए। आख़िर में सब दोष लगानेवाले जा चुके थे। यीशु उस स्त्री के साथ अकेले रह गए, जो अब भी बीच में वहीं खड़ी थी जहाँ उन्होंने उसे खड़ा किया था।

ru.L: А те, услышав [это] и уличаемые совестью, уходили по одному, начиная со старейших; и Иисус остался один, и женщина, которая была посередине.
ru.B: Услышав это, они, уличённые собственной совестью, стали уходить один за другим, начиная со старших. Иисус остался один, а женщина всё ещё стояла посередине.
ru.R: Когда они услышали, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал, совесть подсказала им, что они виноваты. Они стали уходить один за другим, начиная с самых старших. В конце концов все обвинители ушли. Иисус остался с женщиной, которая всё ещё стояла посередине, там, где её поставили.

uk.L: А вони, почувши [це] і викривані сумлінням, виходили один за одним, починаючи від старших; і залишився сам Ісус і жінка, що була посередині.
uk.B: Почувши це, вони, викриті власним сумлінням, пішли один за одним, починаючи від найстарших. Ісус залишився сам, а жінка все ще стояла посередині.
uk.R: Коли вони почули, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав, сумління підказало їм, що вони винні. Один за одним вони пішли геть, починаючи від найстарших. Зрештою обвинувачі розійшлися всі. Ісус залишився з жінкою, яка все ще стояла посередині, там, де її поставили.

ja.L: 彼らは聞いて、良心に責められ、年長の者たちから始まって、一人また一人と出て行った。そして、イエスひとりと、真ん中にいる女とが残された。
ja.B: これを聞くと、彼らは良心に責められて、年長者から始めて一人また一人と去って行った。そして、イエスだけが残り、女は真ん中にいたままであった。
ja.R: イエスの言葉を聞くと、彼らは心の中で、自分にも罪があると気づきました。そして、年をとった人から順に、一人また一人と去って行きました。とうとう、訴えていた人たちはみんないなくなりました。あとには、イエスと、彼らが立たせた真ん中にまだ立っている女の人だけが残りました。

decisions.choice: and being convicted by their conscience (SBLGNT)
alternatives: the words are absent: "when they heard it, they went out one by one"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT text includes the words about their conscience. They are found in many later manuscripts of the passage but missing from others, including some of the earliest that have the story. Some manuscripts also add, after "the older ones", "until the last". A footnote gives the shorter reading. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the older ones: the older men, by age
alternatives: the elders, members of the ruling council
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the elders who sat on the council, but here it is paired with going out "one by one" in order, so the order of age is meant. The oldest leave first, perhaps because they had the longest lives to look back on, though the story does not say why.

decisions.choice: left alone: without the accusers; the woman was still standing where they had put her
alternatives: no one else at all was left in the temple courts
decisions.reason: "Alone" means that the accusers had gone. The woman is still "in the middle", the place where they made her stand (verse 3), in the middle of the people Jesus had been teaching (verse 2), who may still have been there.

decisions.choice: they went out: the imperfect describes them leaving one after another
decisions.reason: The tense shows a process: the accusers went out over a short time, one at a time.

decisions.choice: In the end the accusers were all gone ... where they had put her
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who had gone and why the woman was "in the middle" (meaning decision m3), so that "alone" does not seem to contradict the woman's presence.

decisions.choice: Al final, todos los acusadores se habían ido ... donde la habían puesto
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says who had gone and why the woman was "in the middle" (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: በዕድሜ ከሚበልጡት (those older in age, B); ከትልልቆቹ (the older ones, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as age, not office; ሽማግሌዎች, kept at Literal for the Greek word, can also name the elders of the people.

decisions.choice: "старейших" (L); "старших" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The older men, by age (meaning decision m2), not the elders as an office, which Russian calls "старейшины".

source.text: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ μηδένα θεασάμενος πλὴν τὴς γυναικός εἶπεν αὐτῇ, ποῦ εἰσιν;; ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;

records.literal_gloss: Having straightened up now Jesus and no one having seen except the woman he said to her, Where are they, those the accusers of you? No one you condemned?

en.L: And Jesus, having straightened up and having seen no one except the woman, said to her, "Where are they, those accusers of yours? Has no one condemned you?"
en.B: Jesus straightened up and, seeing no one there but the woman, said to her, "Where are they, the people who were accusing you? Did no one condemn you?"
en.R: Jesus stood up straight and saw that no one was there except the woman. He asked her, "Where did they go, all those people who were accusing you? Did not even one of them condemn you?"

es.L: Y enderezándose Jesús, y no viendo a nadie sino a la mujer, le dijo: «¿Dónde están, esos acusadores tuyos? ¿Nadie te condenó?».
es.B: Jesús se enderezó y, al no ver a nadie más que a la mujer, le dijo: «¿Dónde están los que te acusaban? ¿Ninguno te condenó?».
es.R: Jesús se enderezó y vio que no había nadie más que la mujer. Le preguntó: «¿Adónde se fueron todos los que te acusaban? ¿Ni uno solo de ellos te condenó?».

fr.L: Et Jésus, s’étant redressé et n’ayant vu personne sauf la femme, lui dit : « Où sont-ils, ceux-là, tes accusateurs ? Personne ne t’a condamnée ? »
fr.B: Jésus se redressa et, ne voyant plus que la femme, lui dit : « Où sont-ils, ceux qui t’accusaient ? Personne ne t’a condamnée ? »
fr.R: Jésus s’est redressé et a vu qu’il n’y avait plus personne à part la femme. Il lui a demandé : « Où sont-ils partis, tous ces gens qui t’accusaient ? Aucun d’eux ne t’a condamnée ? »

sw.L: Na Yesu akiinuka, na asimwone mtu isipokuwa yule mwanamke, akamwambia, "Wako wapi wale washtaki wako? Je, hakuna aliyekuhukumu?"
sw.B: Yesu alisimama wima, na asimwone mtu pale isipokuwa yule mwanamke, akamwambia, "Wako wapi wale waliokuwa wakikushtaki? Je, hakuna aliyekuhukumu?"
sw.R: Yesu alisimama wima, akaona kwamba hakuna mtu pale isipokuwa yule mwanamke. Akamwuliza, "Wamekwenda wapi wale watu wote waliokuwa wakikushtaki? Je, hata mmoja wao hakukuhukumu?"

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu đứng thẳng lên, và không thấy ai ngoài người phụ nữ, thì nói với chị: "Họ ở đâu, những người tố cáo chị? Không ai kết án chị sao?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đứng thẳng lên, và không thấy ai ngoài người phụ nữ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi chị: "Những người tố cáo chị đâu cả rồi? Không ai kết án chị sao?"

ko.L: 그리고 예수께서 몸을 일으키시고, 그 여자 외에는 아무도 보지 못하시고, 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "그들은 어디 있느냐, 너를 고발하던 그 사람들은? 아무도 너를 정죄하지 않았느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 몸을 일으키시고 그 여자 말고는 아무도 없는 것을 보시고, 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "너를 고발하던 사람들은 어디 있느냐? 너를 정죄한 사람이 아무도 없느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 몸을 펴고 일어나셔서 보시니, 그 여자 말고는 아무도 없었다. 예수께서 그 여자에게 물으셨다. "너를 고발하던 사람들은 다 어디 갔느냐? 너에게 죄가 있다고 판결한 사람이 하나도 없느냐?"

pt.L: E Jesus, tendo se endireitado e não tendo visto ninguém além da mulher, disse a ela: "Onde estão eles, aqueles seus acusadores? Ninguém a condenou?"
pt.B: Jesus se endireitou e, não vendo ali ninguém além da mulher, disse a ela: "Onde estão aqueles que a acusavam? Ninguém a condenou?"
pt.R: Jesus se levantou e viu que não havia mais ninguém ali além da mulher. Ele perguntou a ela: "Para onde foram todas aquelas pessoas que estavam acusando você? Nenhum deles condenou você?"

am.L: ኢየሱስም ቀና ብሎ ከሴቲቱ በቀር ማንንም ሳያይ እንዲህ አላት፦ «እነዚያ ከሳሾችሽ ወዴት አሉ? ማንም አልፈረደብሽምን?»
am.B: ኢየሱስ ቀና ብሎ ከሴቲቱ በቀር ማንንም ባላየ ጊዜ እንዲህ አላት፦ «ይከስሱሽ የነበሩት ሰዎች ወዴት ናቸው? ማንም አልፈረደብሽም?»

hi.L: और यीशु ने सीधे होकर, और स्त्री को छोड़ किसी को न देखकर, उससे कहा, "वे कहाँ हैं, तुम पर दोष लगानेवाले? क्या किसी ने तुम्हें दोषी नहीं ठहराया?"

hi.R: यीशु सीधे खड़े हुए और देखा कि उस स्त्री के सिवा वहाँ कोई नहीं है। उन्होंने उससे पूछा, "वे सब लोग कहाँ गए जो तुम पर दोष लगा रहे थे? क्या उनमें से एक ने भी तुम्हें दोषी नहीं ठहराया?"

ru.L: Иисус же, выпрямившись и не увидев никого, кроме женщины, сказал ей: «Где они, те твои обвинители? Никто тебя не осудил?»
ru.B: Иисус выпрямился и, не видя никого, кроме женщины, сказал ей: «Где они, те, кто тебя обвинял? Никто тебя не осудил?»
ru.R: Иисус выпрямился и увидел, что там никого нет, кроме женщины. Он спросил её: «Куда же делись все эти люди, которые тебя обвиняли? Неужели ни один из них тебя не осудил?»

uk.L: А Ісус, випроставшись і не побачивши нікого, крім жінки, сказав їй: «Де вони, ті твої обвинувачі? Ніхто тебе не засудив?»
uk.B: Ісус випростався і, не побачивши нікого, крім жінки, сказав їй: «Де ж вони, ті, хто тебе обвинувачував? Ніхто тебе не засудив?»
uk.R: Ісус підвівся і побачив, що там нікого немає, крім жінки. Він запитав її: «Куди поділися всі ті люди, що тебе обвинувачували? Невже жоден із них тебе не засудив?»

ja.L: さて、イエスは身を起こして、女のほかにはだれも見ずに、彼女に言われた。「あなたを訴えていたあの者たちは、どこにいるのか？だれもあなたを罪に定めなかったのか？」
ja.B: イエスは身を起こし、女のほかにはだれもいないのを見て、言われた。「あなたを訴えていた人たちは、どこにいるのか？だれもあなたを罪に定めなかったのか？」
ja.R: イエスは体を起こして、女の人のほかにはだれもいないのを見られました。そして、その人に聞かれました。「あなたを訴えていた人たちは、みんなどこへ行ったのか？一人も、あなたを有罪だと決めなかったのか？」

decisions.choice: and seeing no one except the woman ... Where are they, those accusers of yours? (SBLGNT, with no word of address)
alternatives: "Jesus straightened up and said to her, 'Woman, where are they?'"
"... said to her, 'Woman, where are those accusers of yours?'"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT text has the words "and seeing no one except the woman" and no word of address. Many manuscripts of the passage read differently: some lack the words about seeing no one, and many have Jesus address her as "Woman". The meaning is not affected. A footnote gives the other reading. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: one question: "Where are they, those accusers of yours?"
alternatives: two questions: "Where are they? Those accusers of yours?"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT prints a question mark after "your accusers". The token data marks a question after "are they" instead (with the mark doubled, apparently an error in the data). Either way "those accusers of yours" names who "they" are.

decisions.choice: condemned: gave a verdict of guilty that leads to punishment
decisions.reason: The word means to pronounce someone guilty and pass sentence. No accuser stayed to bring the charge or to throw the first stone, so no sentence had been passed. The question expects the answer "no one".

decisions.choice: the people who were accusing you (B); all those people who were accusing you (R)
decisions.reason: "Accusers" is an uncommon word in speech; Balanced and Readable use the verb.

decisions.choice: los que te acusaban
decisions.reason: As in English: everyday words instead of "acusadores".

decisions.choice: "정죄하다" (L, B); "죄가 있다고 판결하다" (R)
decisions.reason: "정죄하다" is the standard word for a guilty verdict that leads to punishment; Readable spells it out in plain words. The same choice holds in 8:11.

decisions.choice: "chị" for the woman when Jesus speaks to her; "Ta" for himself
decisions.reason: "chị" is respectful and warm without the distance of "bà" or the condescension "con" could carry here; it matches the narrator's "chị". A reviewer may prefer another age word.

decisions.choice: "दोषी ठहराना" here and in 8:11
decisions.reason: One Hindi verb for the two Greek verbs of condemning in 8:10-11, so Jesus's answer plainly takes up his question (meaning decision m3). Jesus addresses the woman with "तुम".

decisions.choice: "あなたを訴えていたあの者たちは、どこにいるのか" (one question, the accusers named first)
alternatives: "彼らはどこにいるのか、あなたを訴えていた者たちは"
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the subject before the question word; the sense is the one question of meaning decision m2. Jesus speaks to the woman gently but plainly.

decisions.choice: "罪に定める" (L, B); "有罪だと決める" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a verdict of guilty that leads to punishment (m3). The same words are used for the simpler verb in 8:11, which carries the same sense there.

decisions.choice: Sir: a polite address to a man
alternatives: Lord, a confession of who Jesus is
decisions.reason: The word is the one later used of Jesus as Lord (20:28), but it was also the ordinary courteous way to address a man. Nothing in the story shows that the woman knows who Jesus is. A footnote gives "Lord".

decisions.choice: Sir
decisions.reason: Shows the polite address (meaning decision m1); "Lord" would put in her mouth a confession the story does not report.

decisions.choice: Señor
decisions.reason: As at 4:11: Spanish "señor" is both the polite "sir" and "Lord" (meaning decision m1). Here it is the polite address.

decisions.choice: Monsieur
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for this address in John: a polite address to a man (meaning decision m1). "Seigneur", familiar from older French Bibles here, would put in her mouth a confession of faith the story does not report. "Monsieur" can sound modern in a Gospel; a native reviewer should confirm it.

decisions.choice: "선생님" for kyrie, with the formal polite style ("없습니다")
decisions.reason: As docs/john-terms.md sets: someone who does not yet know who Jesus is says "Sir", which Korean renders as the respectful "선생님"; the meaning decision's footnote gives "Lord".

decisions.choice: thưa ông
decisions.reason: As the guide sets for "kyrie": a person who does not yet know who Jesus is says "thưa ông"; "thưa Chúa" is the believer's word and is given in the footnote as "Lord".

decisions.choice: senhor, lowercase
decisions.reason: Portuguese has one word for "sir" and "lord"; the capital would make it a confession of Jesus as Lord, which the story does not report (meaning decision m1). Lowercase "senhor" is the polite address, as the English "Sir" is.

decisions.choice: ጌታዬ (sir)
decisions.reason: The polite address to a man, as the meaning decision has it; ጌታዬ is the Amharic courtesy word, while ጌታ ሆይ would make her confess him as Lord.

decisions.choice: "श्रीमान" (L); "महोदय" (B); "साहब" (R)
decisions.reason: A polite address to a man (meaning decision m1); "प्रभु" would put in her mouth a confession the story does not report.

decisions.choice: "господин"
decisions.reason: A polite address to a man (meaning decision m1); "Господи" would put in her mouth a confession the story does not report.

decisions.choice: "пане"
decisions.reason: A polite address to a man (meaning decision m1), as the English "Sir" is; "Господи" would make her confess him as Lord, which the text does not say.

decisions.choice: "主よ" (L); "先生" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The woman uses the ordinary polite address and nothing shows she knows who Jesus is (m1). Following the book's terms for such speakers, Literal keeps the word's form, "主よ", and Balanced and Readable give the polite "先生". She speaks politely.

decisions.choice: condemn: pass sentence on, as in the previous verse
alternatives: judge, in the sense of forming an opinion
decisions.reason: The verb is the simpler form of the one in verse 10 and carries the same sense here: "Neither do I" answers "No one". Jesus does not pass sentence on her, in keeping with what John says elsewhere: God sent the Son not to condemn the world but to save it (3:17).

decisions.choice: no longer sin: a present command, to stop sinning and not go back to it
alternatives: a statement that she has not sinned
decisions.reason: The command assumes that she has sinned, and calls her to a changed life from now on. Jesus says the same words to the man he healed at the pool (5:14).

decisions.choice: mercy together with a call to leave sin
alternatives: a verdict that she was innocent
decisions.reason: Jesus neither denies her guilt nor approves of it. He sends her away without sentence, and he tells her not to sin again. Both parts belong to his answer.

decisions.choice: I do not condemn you either
decisions.reason: The more familiar wording puts "Neither" first, which is closer to the Greek order but is rarely spoken today; every level uses the plain form.
